verdict.rationale:
Cekura's docs describe running thousands of synthetic conversations at once, running the same test scenarios across multiple platforms/models, and managing agents/scenarios/runs/call data in bulk via CLI and SDK, plus cron jobs and CI/CD automation for repeated bulk test runs. This directly matches an AI-native user's need for automation-depth bulk operations across many items (calls, scenarios, agents).

missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of bulk-scale performance, and explicit API documentation of batch create/update endpoints beyond single-call ingestion.
